notes.title: Oriental Dream- release date !
notes.notes:
Hello, dear players! Finally, it's time to announce the official release date of Oriental Dream. Are you ready?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149645/c3aaf8170149b1aa3eb04e5c38f7bc9a34c56409.png[/img]

Oriental Dream will be launched on [b]April 13, 2023![/b] All players will be invited to enter the strange and mysterious oriental world. Unlike other point-and-click puzzle games, the game is designed to let you feel the charm of Chinese culture, which has existed and evolved for over a thousand years!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149645/3f8256d0ed7d4b81d4ac647b6d75bf51e619c3dc.jpg[/img]
（Liangzhu Culture）

The plot and puzzle design is based on the Liangzhu culture, a late Neolithic culture of black pottery and polished jade, around 5,300 to 4,000 years ago, distributed around the Qiantang River basin in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, which is one of the early human ruins. Expanding outward, it covers historical themes such as the Sanxingdui and the Warring States periods. In the end, the spot is placed in the modern 21st century, and the protagonist explores this fascinating history through bizarre events, yielding new insights and understandings.

So you will see interesting puzzles like ancient Chinese characters, ancient totems, ancient astrology, allusions, artifacts, poems, etc. representing Chinese culture, which is the essence of civilization that cannot be reproduced. We are considering how to add the English language to the game so that the world players can feel the spirit of the heritage of this thousand-year-old civilization, but it is a very challenging thing to do, so stay tuned!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43149645/c1773f971feb0d325625c6f9f96ec66dc4bcb080.jpg[/img]
（Dunhuang fresco——Legend of the Nine-Colored Deer）

In addition, another feature is our art style with rock painting, which you will find very bright and vivid, with some mysterious sense of western oil painting. Rock painting is an ancient and simple painting art that is different from Chinese ink painting and western oil painting. The well-known Dunhuang fresco is a representative work that can show the charm of rock painting. During the determination of the art style, we found that rock painting is the most suitable for the background of the game. Now we have combined it with the game very well, hope you can immerse in the game.

If you haven’t already, please add [i]Oriental Dream[/i] to your wishlist and 
feel free to give us feedback about the game in the Steam community.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2090650
